name: haravan
description: Turn Haravan shop data into sales and profit reports, channel and product breakdowns, order lists, and low-stock and inventory summaries.

interface.shortDescription: Sales and stock insights from Haravan
interface.longDescription: Haravan for ChatGPT helps authorized merchants understand sales and stock using read-only data from their connected shop. Ask for net sales, profit or quantity sold over a period, compare this week with the previous week, see a day-by-day trend, break sales down by channel, product, branch or province, find orders created yesterday that are still unfulfilled, see which products are about to run out, or check stock on hand by branch. Sales and stock figures come from Haravan Reports; order lists come from the shop's orders. Reports state the requested date range and the metrics used, and are limited by the shop's permissions and available data. The plugin only reads data; it does not create or change orders, products or stock.
capabilities: Read connected order, sales and inventory data
Summarize sales performance, fulfillment and stock levels
defaultPrompt: Compare this week with last week: net sales, profit, and quantity sold.
For yesterday, list every order still unfulfilled and give me the count.
Which products will run out of stock soonest, and at which branch?
